content.text: A locked_user authentication attempt does not establish the same normal active session access as standard_user.

expected_answer.operand: normal active authenticated session equivalent to standard_user access

content.text: An invalid username or password does not grant an authenticated banking experience.

expected_answer.operand: authenticated banking experience after invalid authentication

content.text: Submitting valid standard_user credentials changes the state from the unauthenticated login state to an authenticated session.
Submitting valid admin_user credentials changes the state from the unauthenticated login state to an authenticated session.
The admin_user session exposes the administrative view and associated authorized capabilities.

expected_answer.operand: administrative view and associated authorized capabilities

content.text: The standard_user session exposes the normal/full-access banking experience available to a standard user.
A locked_user authentication attempt produces a clear user-visible locked-state outcome.
An invalid username or password produces an understandable failure state.

expected_answer.operand: understandable failure state for the authentication attempt

content.text: A slow_user authentication attempt displays a distinguishable loading or progress state while sign-in is in progress.

expected_answer.operand: distinguishable loading or progress state during slow_user sign-in

content.text: After the loading state, slow_user authentication changes the state to the intended internally consistent post-login experience.

expected_answer.baseline: loading or progress state during slow_user sign-in
